caption:
220 medicine samples failed India's own quality tests in August, including paracetamol, BP pills and antibiotics.

CDSCO's August 2026 alert listed 220 samples as "not of standard quality"; one Telma AM batch was flagged as purportedly spurious. Failures are for specific batches, not whole brands. Never stop prescribed medicine on your own.

Source: CDSCO monthly drug alert, via The South First

Jo ghar ki dawai laata hai, usse zaroor bhejo.

caption:
3 out of 4 people in Indian jails have not been convicted of any crime.

Prison Statistics India 2024: about 73% of 5.11 lakh+ inmates are undertrials, still awaiting trial. 9,028 have been inside for more than 5 years. Delhi's jails run at 194.6% capacity.

Source: NCRB Prison Statistics India 2024, via Drishti IAS
